Is a calibration record valid for a run?

Source: R/core-signal-calibrate.R
hr_calibration_valid.Rd

A record holds only for the served model, model version, task, format, prompt hash, effort, module and contract version it was measured on. hr_calibration_valid() is FALSE when any of them differs from key, or is missing from it, and the fields that differ are in the "differs" attribute. A key without contract_version is checked against the running package's contract version, so a record made under another contract version is void.

Usage

hr_calibration_valid(cal, key)

Arguments

cal

An hr_calibration from hr_calibrate_signal().

key

A named list with the fields described under key in hr_calibrate_signal(), for the run the record would be used in.

Value

TRUE or FALSE, with attribute differs naming the fields that did not match.

See also

Other signals: hr_calibrate_signal(), hr_gate_threshold(), hr_signal(), hr_signal_policy()

Examples

graded <- data.frame(score = rep(c(0.9, 0.2), 20), correct = rep(c(TRUE, FALSE), 20),
                     answerable = rep(c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE), 10))
key <- list(served_model = "m-2026", version = "2026", task = "qa", format = "pdf",
            prompt_hash = "abc", effort = NA, module = "iterative")
cal <- hr_calibrate_signal("demo", graded, key, seed = 1, B = 0)
hr_calibration_valid(cal, key)
#> [1] TRUE
#> attr(,"differs")
#> character(0)
hr_calibration_valid(cal, utils::modifyList(key, list(served_model = "m-2027")))
#> [1] FALSE
#> attr(,"differs")
#> [1] "served_model"
